evidence: Checks the SELL_CARD property (exact guest string 0x7001c4bcaf), resolves its id value, updates the associated counters at +0xb4/+0xc8, and calls the DD context status helper before final status/record updates. No indexed caller is available. decompiled/main/main_0078.c:23383-23417.

In the SSL packet.c code path (exact guest string 0x7001cd05c4), checks the packet buffer, calls grow_openssl_buffer_clean when it must expand storage, then adjusts the packet buffer pointers/lengths and returns success/failure. A packet-writing caller invokes it and branches on the result. decompiled/main/main_0156.c:35507-35523,35543-35615; caller decompiled/main/main_0157.c:8666-8674.

Evaluates the supplied context and selected records, checks assignment/status conditions, and calls the named update_bench_position_assignment helper when the conditions pass; related branches call context_selected_records_have_mask_0e and evaluate_attribute_context_predicate. A caller invokes it as part of this context-driven game update. No direct rodata strings resolve in the body. decompiled/main/main_0054.c:37562-37736; caller decompiled/main/main_0033.c:46401-46405.

Builds a temporary table, loops over up to 27 indexed entries, evaluates ranked-record metrics for each and accumulates their float values, then passes the resulting table to the qsort import. Its caller uses the routine in a ranking calculation. No direct rodata strings resolve in the body. decompiled/main/main_0055.c:1851-1936; caller decompiled/main/main_0055.c:1098-1104.

Retrieves an attribute-context status, derives the signed value and formatting mode, calls format_signed_integer_with_thousands_separators, and assembles the formatted result. Its caller consumes the value in an attribute display path. No direct rodata strings resolve in the body. decompiled/main/main_0053.c:54313-54427; caller decompiled/main/main_0033.c:52430-52438.

When the status code selects the franchise postgame path, initializes summary fields, calls build_end_game_pitcher_summary and populate_franchise_news_headlines along with the other summary-population routines, then tail-calls the final summary helper. The caller passes the summary record through this initialization and population chain. No direct rodata strings resolve in the body. decompiled/main/main_0104.c:29783-29838; caller decompiled/main/main_0105.c:23286-23294.

Iterates the nested-attribute entries attached to the input player record, resolves an attribute context for each entry, and calls format_nested_player_attribute_value (plus its alternate formatting path). A caller fills the record's attribute count before invoking this formatter. No direct rodata strings resolve in the body. decompiled/main/main_0111.c:9507-9609; caller decompiled/main/main_0111.c:12140-12146.

Selects the formatting path by the supplied value-type code, obtains a value through nested_attribute_block_get_float or player_attribute_get_float, formats it through the decimal formatter helpers, and passes the prepared value to the display builder. Its caller is populate_player_context_attribute_block. No direct rodata strings resolve in the body. decompiled/main/main_0034.c:36043-36116; caller decompiled/main/main_0123.c:39005-39013.
